npc-description.label: Tavern keeper
npc-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e tavern keeper NPC: race, age, one interesting visual detail, manner of speaking with patrons, one secret or story they know.

npc-description.label: Guard captain
npc-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e city guard captain NPC: race, look, attitude toward adventurers, the crime they're currently investigating.

npc-description.label: Shop merchant
npc-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e shopkeeper NPC: race, what they sell, pricing policy (fair/greedy), one unusual item in their stock.

npc-description.label: Religious zealot
npc-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e cult fanatic NPC: which deity, depth of fanaticism, the trigger that would make them attack, the symbol or clothing that gives them away.

npc-description.label: Mysterious traveler
npc-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e mysterious traveler NPC: hints of past, reason for being in this tavern/city, one suspicious action that may alert the players.

scene-description.label: Forest glade
scene-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e forest glade scene. Give two atmospheres: day and night. Sounds, smells, what's visible, what's hidden.

scene-description.label: Dungeon level 3
scene-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e dungeon level-3 scene. Atmosphere (humidity, light, air), traces of prior occupants, hint at the floor's main danger.

scene-description.label: Port city
scene-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e port city scene. Noise, smells, types of people in the crowd, typical crime, main landmark (lighthouse/temple/market).

scene-description.label: Ruined temple
scene-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e ruined temple scene. Which deity was worshipped here, cause of ruin, what survived, what still works, feeling on entry.

scene-description.label: Mountain snowstorm
scene-description.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e mountain pass during a snowstorm. Visibility, cold effect, sounds, risks (cliff fall, frostbite), the one survival landmark.

srd-lookup.label: Grapple
srd-lookup.prompt: Explain D&D 5e SRD rule: Grapple. Athletics vs Athletics/Acrobatics, what the grappled creature loses (speed=0), how to escape. No homebrew.

srd-lookup.label: Cover & concealment
srd-lookup.prompt: Explain D&D 5e SRD rule: cover (half/three-quarters/total) vs concealment. Effect on AC and skill checks.

srd-lookup.label: Counterspell
srd-lookup.prompt: Explain D&D 5e SRD rule: Counterspell. Reaction timing, level check for higher-level spells, what the caster vs target sees.

srd-lookup.label: Death saves
srd-lookup.prompt: Explain D&D 5e SRD rule: Death Saving Throws. Scale, critical successes/fails, effect of damage at 0 HP.

srd-lookup.label: Concentration
srd-lookup.prompt: Explain D&D 5e SRD rule: Concentration. What breaks it, CON-save formula, which typical spells require concentration.

free-chat.label: Side-quest
free-chat.prompt: Give 3 side-quest ideas for a D&D 5e level 3-5 party. Format: hook (1 sentence), complication, reward.

free-chat.label: Plot twist
free-chat.prompt: Suggest 3 plot twists for the current D&D 5e story arc. Each must be unexpected but logical given prior events.

free-chat.label: NPC morality
free-chat.prompt: Help me determine an NPC's moral compass: 5 situational choices and how this NPC reacts to each. Format: situation → reaction.

free-chat.label: City economy
free-chat.prompt: Describe a D&D 5e fantasy city's economy: main source of income, leading guilds, typical price for bread/ale/lodging, smuggling.

free-chat.label: Reaction to failure
free-chat.prompt: The players failed at [action]. Give 3 GM-side complications (mild/medium/harsh) tied to that failure, no deus ex machina.
